messages:
clara: idea: attribute cache savings to hourly windows instead of session amortization to reduce billing spikes in console previews.

diego: short why this helps?

clara: multi-step flows currently concentrate huge future-token savings on one session. hourly windows spread credit and make diffs meaningful.

anya: shared-cache concern?

clara: assign deterministic partition_key = hash(cache_key) % 1024 to avoid per-request state. if multiple tenants hit same cached item, prorate by sampled hit shares within the hour.

mike: sampling for billing = legal pain. What's error and fallback?

clara: 2% sampling with bootstrap CIs. if CI < 0.7 mark as ESTIMATE and optionally round up. enterprise tenants can opt-out via tenant flag: control_plane.disable_hourly_crediting=true.

diego: router interaction? credits need route_id and sku to avoid subsidizing fallbacks.

clara: router must emit route_id and sku on hit events; API shape minimal: POST /internal/econ/credits {tenant_id, window_start, window_end, strategy, entries:[{sku, tokens_saved, partition_key, route_id}]}

billing-bot: checklist: run 14d sim, bias report, add feature flag, add console preview toggle + diff slider, expose CI in UI.

anya: tests: simulate skewed distribution day and sudden tenant bursts.

mike: infra estimate: I'll run cost sim and flag heavy cross-tenant proration windows.

clara: plan: proto + docs PR this week, sim results next Tue, UX copy from anya. sync Fri? :calendar:
